wiki_overview.content:
<blog>

# GOFT3 - Financial Operations Management System

## Project Introduction

GOFT3 (Gestion des Opérations Financière Titre 3) is a comprehensive financial operations management desktop application built with React, TypeScript, and Tauri. The system manages financial operations, engagements, payments, beneficiaries, and various financial documents for government or institutional financial management workflows.

### Purpose Statement
The application provides a complete solution for managing financial operations including:
- Financial operations tracking and lifecycle management
- Engagement and payment processing workflows  
- Beneficiary and document management
- Financial reporting and analytics
- Multi-user collaboration with real-time presence
- Offline-first architecture with cloud synchronization

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Financial Compliance**: Ensure proper financial documentation and audit trails
- **Multi-platform Support**: Desktop applications for Windows and Linux via Electron/Tauri
- **Offline Capability**: Full functionality without internet connectivity
- **Real-time Collaboration**: Multiple users working simultaneously
- **Data Integrity**: Comprehensive validation and consistency checks
- **Arabic Language Support**: Full RTL interface with Arabic translations

### Target Audience
- Government financial departments
- Institutional finance managers  
- Financial auditors and compliance officers
- Administrative staff handling financial operations

## Technical Architecture

The application follows a modern React-based architecture with offline-first capabilities and cloud synchronization.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[React UI Layer] --> B[Context State Management]
    B --> C[Data Service Layer]
    C --> D[Supabase Cloud Database]
    C --> E[Tauri SQLite Local DB]
    C --> F[Local Storage Backup]
    
    G[Authentication] --> H[User Session Management]
    I[Notification System] --> J[Real-time Events]
    K[Export/Import] --> L[CSV/XLSX/PDF Generation]
    
    M[Update Service] --> N[Auto-updates]
    O[Security Layer] --> P[Password Hashing & Validation]
```

### Component Breakdown

**Frontend Architecture:**
- **React Components**: Modular UI components with TypeScript interfaces
- **State Management**: Context API with React Query for data fetching
- **Routing**: Custom navigation system with page guards
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with Bootstrap Icons
- **Internationalization**: Arabic language support with RTL layout

**Backend Integration:**
- **Supabase**: Cloud database with real-time subscriptions
- **Tauri**: Native SQLite database for offline functionality
- **Electron**: Alternative desktop runtime for broader compatibility

### Design Patterns

1. **Offline-First Pattern**: Data cached locally with background sync
2. **Provider Pattern**: Context providers for global state management
3. **Repository Pattern**: Abstracted data access layer
4. **Observer Pattern**: Real-time event broadcasting
5. **Strategy Pattern**: Pluggable storage backends

### System Relationships

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant UI as React UI
    participant DC as DataContext
    participant Supabase as Supabase
    participant Tauri as Tauri SQLite
    
    UI->>+DC: User Action
    DC->>+Supabase: Sync Changes
    Supabase-->>-DC: Response
    DC->>+Tauri: Mirror to Local DB
    Tauri-->>-DC: Confirmation
    DC-->>-UI: Update UI State
```

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points
- **Application Root**: `App.tsx` - Main application component with routing and authentication
- **Entry Point**: `index.tsx` - Application bootstrap and provider setup
- **Desktop Entry**: `electron.js` - Electron main process configuration

### Core Modules

**State Management**:
- `context/DataContext.tsx` - Centralized data management with offline sync
- `context/LanguageContext.tsx` - Internationalization context
- `context/ToastContext.tsx` - Global notification system

**Database Services**:
- `services/supabaseClient.ts` - Supabase client configuration
- `services/tauriService.ts` - Tauri native database operations
- `services/dbSchema.ts` - Database schema definitions

**Type Definitions**:
- `types.ts` - Complete TypeScript interfaces for all entities

### Configuration Approach
- **Environment Config**: `package.json` - Dependencies and build configuration
- **Build Tools**: Vite for development and production builds
- **Desktop Packaging**: Tauri and Electron configurations
- **CSS Framework**: Tailwind CSS with custom configuration

### External Dependencies

**Core Framework**:
- React 18.2.0 with TypeScript
- Vite 5.4.21 for build tooling
- Tailwind CSS 3.4.19 for styling

**Database & Backend**:
- Supabase JS Client 2.39.8 for cloud database
- Tauri App 2.2.0 for native desktop features

**UI & UX**:
- Framer Motion 11.15.0 for animations
- React Window 2.2.7 for virtualized lists
- Lucide React 1.14.0 for icons

**Utilities**:
- ExcelJS 4.4.0 for spreadsheet generation
- jsPDF 4.2.0 for PDF generation
- html2canvas 1.4.1 for screenshot capture

### Integration Points

**Authentication Flow**:
```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Login
    Login --> Authenticated: Valid Credentials
    Login --> Error: Invalid Credentials
    Authenticated --> IdleLock: Inactivity
    IdleLock --> Authenticated: Password Entered
    Authenticated --> Logout: Manual Logout
    Logout --> [*]
```

**Data Synchronization**:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[User Action] --> B{Online?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Sync to Supabase]
    B -->|No| D[Queue Action]
    C --> E[Mirror to SQLite]
    E --> F[Update UI]
    D --> G[Background Sync]
    G --> C
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Financial Operations Management**:
- Complete operation lifecycle from creation to closure
- Document attachment and management
- Beneficiary tracking and banking information
- Category and program organization

**Engagement and Payment Processing**:
- Engagement creation and validation
- Payment processing with multiple deduction types
- Mandate and certificate generation
- Financial status monitoring

**Reporting and Analytics**:
- Financial status reports by structure
- Monthly commitments and payments tracking
- Custom report generation
- Export to CSV, XLSX, and PDF formats

### Implementation Highlights

**Security Features**:
- Password hashing with bcrypt-ts
- Role-based access control (admin/user/viewer)
- Page-level permissions
- Session timeout with idle lock screen

**Data Integrity**:
- Foreign key validation across related tables
- Automatic repair of inconsistent data
- Transaction support for complex operations
- Backup and restore functionality

**User Experience**:
- Real-time presence indicators
- Global search across all entities
- Keyboard shortcuts for power users
- Responsive design for various screen sizes

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[Operations Module] --> B[Documents]
    A --> C[Beneficiaries]
    A --> D[Engagements]
    A --> E[Paiements]
    
    F[Reports Module] --> G[Financial Status]
    F --> H[Monthly Reports]
    F --> I[Custom Reports]
    
    J[Admin Module] --> K[Users Management]
    J --> L[System Settings]
    J --> M[Configuration]
```

**Advanced Features**:
- **Real-time Collaboration**: Multiple users can work simultaneously with presence indicators
- **Offline-First**: Full functionality without internet with automatic synchronization
- **Multi-language Support**: Arabic interface with RTL layout support
- **Auto-updates**: Built-in update mechanism for seamless version upgrades
- **Export Capabilities**: Generate professional financial documents in multiple formats

---

**Sources:**
- [package.json](package.json)
- [App.tsx](App.tsx)
- [types.ts](types.ts)
- [services/supabaseClient.ts](services/supabaseClient.ts)
- [context/DataContext.tsx](context/DataContext.tsx)
- [services/tauriService.ts](services/tauriService.ts)

</blog>
